title: Release security review
notes: The v1.1 release security review is recorded at docs/implementation/14.4/security-review.json: reviewer_status PASS_WITH_FINDINGS, open_blocker_high 0, 10 findings (3 LOW, 7 INFORMATIONAL), ready_for_next_task true. Scope covered the ADR-020 logging path and the SEC-5 rewrite, the ADR-016 embedded settings page and elevation-gated administrator save path, the ADR-021 rejection activity log, and release breadth (ADR-005 secret boundary, ADR-012 webhook boundary, state integrity, bounded inputs, and the packaged artifact). All prior security findings (final-review SEC-1..SEC-9 and the 9.2/9.3/10.3/11.1 reviews) were re-checked with no regression.

Accepted limitations recorded in docs/limitations.md (task 14.4's documented documentation impact): SEC-10 (LOW: configured provider API keys / webhook secret are not length-bounded, a memory-amplification hardening gap), SEC-11 (LOW: EnabledLibraries entries are not count/length-bounded or GUID-validated, admin-only and fails closed), and SEC-12 (INFORMATIONAL: base-URL user information is not rejected, pre-existing SEC-10.3-4). The SEC-2 evidence line reference was corrected for the v1.1 file growth without changing the finding.

One open LOW documentation finding SEC-14.4-03 remains: docs/planning/v1.1.md lines 146-147 still carry the pre-logging 'zero logging call sites' current-state line (a SEC-10.3-2 / P10-F3 carry-over missed by Phase 13). It is non-blocking and disclosed, not hidden.

The independent implementation review verified the recorded audit's code claims and confirmed reviewer_status APPROVED with 0 blockers and 0 required changes (docs/implementation/14.4/reviewer-report.json). No src/, tests/, build metadata, manifest, or release-artifact change was made; no git commit/tag was created by any subagent.
The security-reviewer ran at variant max (the runtime-reported variant for that session); the orchestrator recorded the runtime-reported model/variant, not its own configuration.
Runtime figures are authoritative from the OpenCode session usage endpoint (.opencode/scripts/collect-session-usage.sh); no values were estimated.
